note: One route, two widths, and a fixture it cannot photograph without. `/collection/replace/summary/[uploadId]` needs a CONFIRMED upload carrying a summary_payload, and the contested section only draws where committed demand exceeds supply — the headless probe account has no committed deck at all, so a run with no fixture photographs a working feature as an empty one. `pnpm seed:summary <userId>` writes that fixture (two committed decks a month apart, and a receipt with all three sections populated) and prints the URL; it takes --clean. SUMMARY_UPLOAD comes from the environment for the same reason the other inventories take their deck id that way: no account's row id belongs in a checked-in file. The second row is the same route with its issues line opened, because IssueInspector reachable after the confirm is the one thing ruled IN scope for this PR that a still photograph of the page would otherwise miss. No `shares` block yet: ContestedCardRow's second surface is /decks/[id]/changes and lands in PR 4, and a shares block naming one route proves nothing. The third row exists because the phone's first screenful ends inside `Still to buy`: the contested section is the one thing this PR adds that a phone shot of the fold cannot show, and a row that photographs the top of the page reads as coverage while proving nothing about it.
